name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
monetization: Sells Instinct GPUs, EPYC CPUs, and rack-scale AI systems; anchor OpenAI 6GW deal is paired with a milestone-vested warrant booked as contra-revenue.
description_md: AMD designs EPYC server CPUs, Instinct data-center GPUs (MI350 today, MI400/MI450 rack-scale 'Helios' systems from 2026), client/embedded processors, and the ROCm software stack. Fabless: leading-edge manufacturing at TSMC, HBM from the memory triopoly. The 2025 ZT Systems acquisition ($4.9B) added rack-scale systems design; the manufacturing arm was resold to Sanmina (~$3B reported, unverified detail). Data center is now the majority of revenue (58% in Q2 2026).
ai_monetization_md: Direct sales of Instinct GPUs and EPYC CPUs into AI data centers — data-center segment revenue of $6.7B in Q2 2026, +107% y/y. The demand book is anchored by three arrangements: (1) OpenAI's commitment to deploy 6GW of Instinct GPUs starting with 1GW of MI450 in 2H 2026, paired with a warrant granting OpenAI up to 160M AMD shares at $0.01, vesting in tranches on deployment and AMD share-price milestones — AMD accounts for vested warrant value as **contra-revenue**, reducing recognized revenue from OpenAI purchases (the warrant_for_revenue circularity pattern); (2) a $10B strategic collaboration with Saudi Arabia's Humain (up to 500MW over five years initially; a Humain–AMD–Cisco JV targets 1GW by 2030); (3) a July 2026 agreement to invest up to $5B in Anthropic as part of a compute deal — investing in a customer whose purchases return as AMD revenue.
ai_strategy_md: Position as the credible rack-scale second source to Nvidia: annual Instinct cadence, open ROCm software, and full-system Helios designs from the ZT Systems capability. Lock in anchor customers with aligned economics — equity upside for OpenAI via the warrant, sovereign partnership with Humain, equity investment into Anthropic — and ride the same TSMC leading-edge/advanced-packaging supply chain as Nvidia. Management frames the OpenAI deal as generating 'tens of billions' of annual revenue as deployments scale.
risk_notes_md: **Warrant/circularity:** up to 160M shares (~10% of shares outstanding) issuable to OpenAI at $0.01; contra-revenue treatment means reported revenue from OpenAI is net of equity given to win it — analysts debate the organic quality of this revenue. **Customer concentration:** OpenAI (6GW), Humain, and Anthropic are large, partly unfunded commitments; OpenAI's ability to finance 6GW is itself the subject of the ecosystem-wide funding-gap debate. **Supply:** shares the CoWoS/HBM bottlenecks with Nvidia. **China:** export controls removed the MI308 China business from guidance (same regime as Nvidia's H20).

observations.notes: Record; +50% y/y. Non-GAAP EPS $1.66; GAAP net income $2.3B. Q3 guide $12.7–13.3B (~+41% y/y).
+107% y/y on EPYC and Instinct; 58% of total revenue.
Exercise price $0.01/share; tranches vest as OpenAI deployments scale from 1GW to 6GW and on AMD share-price/stock-performance milestones. Vested value is booked as contra-revenue (see FY2025 10-K).
Up to 500MW of AI compute over five years initially; separate Humain–AMD–Cisco JV targets 1GW by 2030. Realized dollars undisclosed.

events.title: OpenAI partnership: 6GW of Instinct GPUs, warrant for up to 160M AMD shares
events.why_it_matters: AMD's largest-ever AI win; first 1GW of MI450 deploys 2H 2026. The $0.01 warrant with milestone vesting is the canonical warrant-for-revenue structure and is accounted for as contra-revenue.

events.title: AMD to invest up to $5B in Anthropic as part of a compute deal
events.why_it_matters: AMD adopts the Nvidia playbook of equity-seeding a lab customer — investment and GPU purchases flow in a loop (equity_for_revenue pattern).

events.title: Completes $4.9B ZT Systems acquisition
events.why_it_matters: Gave AMD rack-scale systems design needed to sell full AI racks (Helios) rather than chips; manufacturing arm resold to Sanmina for ~$3B (reported, unverified detail).

sources.notes: Warrant accounting (contra-revenue) and ZT Systems treatment.
